subject: POC access orchestration & close milestones
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neil <liam.oneil@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: POC access orchestration & close milestones

Liam —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our discussion, I put together a concise MAP focused on the POC environment setup so your infra team can validate networking and compliance requirements ahead of the pilot. Attached is a two-page milestones PDF and an IP allowlist template.

High-level ask list for this week:
- Org bootstrap: we need a service account and a short-lived bootstrap token for initial API key provisioning (see step 1 in the attached PDF).
- API keys: Redwood will provision initial read-only keys for telemetry + an evaluation key for model calls. We need the org slug and SSO domain to bind keys.
- IP allowlist: add the egress CIDRs in ip-allowlist_template.csv to your firewall for the test window (we recommend a 4-hour canary).
- VPC peering: options are transit gateway or direct peering — we included both network diagrams in the doc; Marissa will own the peering playbook.

Proposed timeline:
- Tue (today): confirm owner + share org slug and service account email
- Wed: firewall entries + VPC peering request raised
- Thu: canary run + validation; brief sync to signoff and move to pilot

If that works, Marissa will send the network checklist and I’ll open the HubSpot MAP record (HS-123456).

Thanks — short and actionable is my preference here.

—Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Liam O'Neil <liam.oneil@aureliahealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 13:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC access orchestration & close milestones

Hi Vanessa —

Appreciate the concise list. Two quick constraints from infra:
1) We can only open egress for a CIDR range per team change window; earliest opportunity is Wed 09:00–11:00 PST.
2) For peering we need a completed network impact form (internal). Can you confirm the autonomous system number and expected bandwidth?

A few clarifications:
- Org slug: aurelia-health-prod (we'll create a test org under aurelia-health-sandbox for the eval)
- Service account: infra-integration@aureliahealth.com (I'll provision and DM credentials)

I'll attach the network impact form from our side once you provide the ASN/bandwidth. If we can lock the window Wed morning, we can do the canary Thu afternoon.

—Liam
Director, Infrastructure
Aurelia Health

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neil <liam.oneil@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC access orchestration & close milestones

Liam — thanks, that's helpful. Quick answers below and next steps.

- ASN and bandwidth: Redwood uses ASN 64512 for transit peering; recommended baseline is 100 Mbps for the evaluation phase. If your NOC needs a different ASN mapping we can support explicit route advertisements.
- We'll provision two keys: "aurelia_eval_read" (evaluation usage) and "aurelia_telemetry" (metrics only). Keys are short-lived and bound to the org slug you provided.
- Regarding the network impact form: attached doc "aurelia-vpc-peering-instructions.docx" contains the exact parameters for your NOC to prefill (VPC CIDRs, BGP info, ACL guidance).

Marissa — can you send the peering step-by-step and the allowlist CSV prefilled with Redwood egress CIDRs? Also note: for the canary we recommend opening only the eval model Egress ports and restricting management plane to your service account IP range.

If Wed 09:00–11:00 PST is the only window, we'll mark that for the firewall change and plan the canary Thu 14:00–16:00 PST. Please confirm.

—Vanessa

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neil <liam.oneil@aureliahealth.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jul 2025 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC access orchestration & close milestones

Liam / team —

Attached is the network checklist and IP CSV prefilled with the following egress CIDRs we need whitelisted for the canary: 34.82.120.0/22, 34.82.124.0/22, 52.44.10.0/24. Please paste those into your firewall rule template and confirm when applied.

Step-by-step peering highlights (short):
1) Create peering request in your console referencing our VPC-id: rwd-peer-vpc-001 and ASN 64512.
2) Share your VPC CIDR and preferred BGP range — we recommend avoiding overlapping /16s.
3) We'll exchange pre-shared keys and validate route propagation in staging (expect ~15–20 min).
4) Once routes are visible, open egress for canary window only and run a smoke harness (we'll provide a 15-min script).

Checklist items we need from you before Wed 09:00: org slug (confirmed), service account email (confirmed), and confirmation that the NOC will submit the peering request during the 09:00–11:00 window.

I've also added a brief rollback plan in the PDF — if the canary hits errors we'll revert rules and rotate the eval API key.

—Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Liam O'Neil <liam.oneil@aureliahealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jul 2025 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC access orchestration & close milestones

All set — NOC submitted peering request at 09:15 Wed and firewall updates applied at 09:45. We validated route propagation and ran your 15-min smoke harness (results: successful auth + 98% successful model responses during the run).

Next steps we need from Redwood to close the MAP:
- Provide the final eval key (with the agreed 72-hour window) and confirm which endpoints are reachable over peering vs public egress.
- Share the MAP signoff (HS-123456) with a short list of acceptance criteria we can route to procurement for the SOW.

Thanks for staying on the timings — happy to extend the pilot if we need additional traffic.

—Liam
